|lore=Ishi Tib accountant. Experienced administrator. Freelance consultant. Worked for many planetary governors. Knows how to get the most out of any taxation scheme.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. For each of opponent’s non-battleground locations on table, your Force generation is +1. Your leaders are deploy -2 to same site. Once per game, may take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Harc Seff (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Harc Seff (V) (Virtual Set 5)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 1, slip 8 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “P 2. Your Force generation is +1 for each of opponent's non-battleground locations on table. Your leaders deploy -2 to same site. Once per game, may ▲ one Immediate Effect.” Stats line: “POWER 2 ABILITY 2”. Deploy 2, forfeit 4. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•8” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Harc Seff (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]): the revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf], page 1, slip 8), after the Committee's errata of 10 June 2003, on the same old slip: “P 2. Your Force generation is +1 for each of opponent's non-battleground locations on table. Your leaders deploy -2 to same site. Once per game, may ▲ one Immediate Effect.” Stats line: “POWER 2 ABILITY 2 ARMOR 3” (the first sheet: “POWER 2 ABILITY 2”). '''What changed:''' the words are the same; only the stats line differs.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 8), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. For each of opponent’s non-battleground locations on table, your Force generation is +1. Your leaders are deploy -2 to same site. Once per game, may take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
